metadata.title: Land Registry ZKP
metadata.description: Privacy-preserving Land Use Rights registry using a Merkle tree and Zero-Knowledge Proofs on Ethereum

landing.residentBody: Generate a proof from your certificate bundle, verify one you were given, or look up a property’s history.
landing.govBody: Issue certificates, handle transfers at the counter, and publish batched changes to the registry root. Requires an officer key and a wallet.

gate.title: Registry officer sign-in
gate.intro: The portal key authenticates this browser to the registry API. Publishing a root is signed separately, with your wallet.
gate.label: Portal key
gate.hint: Held for this tab only. Closing it signs you out.
gate.errorRejected: That key was rejected by the registry API.
gate.errorUnreachable: Could not reach the registry API. The key was not checked.
gate.errorUnreachableDetail: Could not reach the registry API ({detail}). The key was not checked.

govImport.title: Import records
govImport.description: Upload a cadastral CSV export. Every row is validated against the statutory land-use code table before it can be issued.
govImport.emptyBody: Drop a .csv export here or browse for one. The file is checked row by row first; nothing is written until you import the valid rows.
govImport.checkedTitle: Checked {name} — nothing has been written yet
govImport.catalogEmptyBody: Commune names in this file could not be checked against the units in force. Seed the catalog with pnpm --filter backend run seed:admin-units <file> before relying on these addresses.
govImport.errorsBody: Fix these in the source export and upload the file again. Superseded land codes, renamed agencies and district-tier addresses are rejected as invalid values; the registry does not translate outdated data.
govImport.noValidRows: No row in this file can be imported.
govImport.committedBody: They are now IMPORTED and can be selected for issuance. {skipped} row(s) were skipped because their property ID was already registered.

govIssuance.title: Issuance
govIssuance.description: Select imported properties, sign the new Merkle root with your wallet, then download the certificate archive.
govIssuance.emptyBody: Properties appear here once a CSV import has been accepted. Import a file first, then come back to draft a batch.
govIssuance.selectAllOnPage: Select every property on this page
govIssuance.creating: Generating secrets and projecting the root
govIssuance.archiveWarning: After confirmation the archive holds every owner's secret.json for this round and is deleted after 7 days. Distribute the folders before then: a lost secret means re-issuing that plot.
govIssuance.blockedTitle: Change set draft #{id} is waiting to be signed
govIssuance.blockedBody: Only one draft may wait for a signature at a time, because a root commits to the whole tree and two drafts computed in parallel would overwrite each other. Publish or discard the change set first.
govIssuance.confirmedTitle: Issuance draft #{id} published at root version {version}
govIssuance.confirmedBody: Download the archive from the list below and hand each property folder to its owner.
govIssuance.discardedTitle: The draft was discarded; its properties are back in the list
govIssuance.historyEmpty: No round has been drafted yet.

govTransfers.title: Transfers
govTransfers.description: Run a transfer with both parties present, then work the approval queue. Approving queues the change, it does not publish it.
govTransfers.counterPrivacy: Both secrets exist only in this browser while the transfer is prepared. Only the proof and the public signals are sent to the registry.
govTransfers.draftWarning: A draft is waiting to be published. A proof made now is tied to the current root and becomes invalid once that draft publishes.
govTransfers.step1Body: Load the seller's plot ZIP, or its receipt.json and secret.json together. Check the seller's identity documents yourself: the bundle proves possession of the secret, not who holds it.
govTransfers.checkingBundle: Checking the bundle against the registry
govTransfers.bundle_multiple-properties: The selection contains more than one plot. Select the single plot folder or ZIP.
govTransfers.bundle_invalid-json: A file in the bundle is not valid JSON.
govTransfers.bundle_invalid-shape: The files are not a registry receipt and owner secret.
govTransfers.bundle_property-mismatch: receipt.json and secret.json belong to different plots.
govTransfers.issuesTitle: The registry would refuse this transfer
govTransfers.issue_leaf-mismatch: The receipt was altered after issuance: its certificate fields no longer produce its leaf.
govTransfers.issue_secret-mismatch: secret.json does not open the owner commitment in receipt.json.
govTransfers.issue_not-issued: The plot is not currently issued (it may have been revoked).
govTransfers.issue_not-current-owner: This receipt belongs to a previous owner; the plot has changed hands since.
govTransfers.issue_encumbered: The plot is encumbered and cannot be transferred.
govTransfers.issue_community-land: Land held by a residential community cannot be transferred (Điều 39 khoản 2 Luật Đất đai 2024).
govTransfers.step2Body: A new secret is generated in this browser. Hand it to the buyer before submitting: after publication it is the only proof of their ownership, and the registry never holds a copy.
govTransfers.acknowledge: The buyer has received the secret file
govTransfers.termLabel: Minimum remaining term the buyer accepts (years)
govTransfers.termHint: 0 proves only that the right has not expired. A longer threshold is proven without revealing the expiry date.
govTransfers.termInvalid: Enter a whole number of years, 0 or more.
govTransfers.submitLocked: Download the buyer secret and confirm the buyer received it first.
govTransfers.proving: Generating the transfer proof in this browser
govTransfers.proveFailed: The proof could not be generated
govTransfers.submittedTitle: Transfer request #{id} is waiting for approval
govTransfers.submittedBody: Proof generated in {seconds} s. Both secrets have been cleared from this page.
govTransfers.awaitingPublication: Waiting for the next change set
govTransfers.approvedTitle: Transfer #{id} approved; it will publish with the next change set
govTransfers.rootMismatchHint: The registry published a new root after this proof was made, so the request was rejected automatically. Both parties must return to the counter.
govTransfers.staleTimestampHint: On a local hardhat node an idle chain keeps an old block timestamp; mine a block (evm_mine) and approve again.
govTransfers.bundleTitle: The buyer receipt is not available

govChanges.title: Changes
govChanges.description: Collect approved transfers and revocations into one ChangeSet, sign it, and publish a single new root.
govChanges.emptyBody: Approved transfers and queued revocations collect here. Batching them means one root publish instead of one per change.
govChanges.pendingTitle: Waiting for the next change set
govChanges.capNote: A change set carries at most 50 revocations; the oldest go first and the rest wait for the next round.
govChanges.loadError: Could not load the pending changes
govChanges.blockedTitle: Issuance draft #{id} is waiting to be signed
govChanges.blockedBody: Only one draft may wait for a signature at a time, because a root commits to the whole tree and two drafts computed in parallel would overwrite each other. Publish or discard the issuance draft first.
govChanges.draftDeferred: {count} more revocation(s) wait for the next round (cap of 50 per change set).
govChanges.revocationsPermanent: Revocations are recorded on chain permanently. Each revoked plot leaves the tree, so its owner can no longer produce any proof.
govChanges.confirmedTitle: Change set #{id} published at root version {version}
govChanges.confirmedBody: Buyers of the published transfers can now receive their receipt from the transfer queue.
govChanges.discardedTitle: The draft was discarded; its changes are back in the queue
govChanges.revokeBody: The request waits here and takes effect when the next change set publishes.
govChanges.detailHint: Only the keccak256 hash of this text goes on chain (D45). The text stays in the registry database and never appears in the public history.
govChanges.detailRequired: Describe the decision this revocation is based on.

residentProof.title: Generate a proof
residentProof.description: Prove a fact about your title without handing over the certificate. The proof is computed on this device and your secret never leaves it.
residentProof.emptyBody: Select the ZIP you received from the registry. It holds the receipt and the secret needed to compute a proof, both of which stay in this browser.

residentVerify.title: Verify a proof
residentVerify.description: Check a proof against the registry root published on chain, confirm the issuing authority, and see whether the title has been revoked.
residentVerify.emptyBody: Upload the proof.json an owner gave you. You will see which claims it establishes, and nothing about the record beyond them.

residentLookup.title: Property history
residentLookup.description: Every registry event for a parcel, by its property ID. Owners appear as commitments, never as names.
residentLookup.label: Property ID
residentLookup.emptyBody: Parcel IDs run from 0 to 1048575, the range of the depth-20 tree. The history shows issuance, transfers and revocations with the root version each was published under.
residentLookup.hint: Property IDs run from 0 to 1048575, the range of the depth-20 tree.
residentLookup.invalidId: A property ID is a whole number from 0 to 1048575
residentLookup.notFoundBody: Check the number. Nothing has ever been recorded under it.
residentLookup.publicTierNote: This page shows only what is public: the owner as a commitment, the leaf hash, and which published root it belongs to. The certificate details — address, area, land-use code, term, encumbrance — are not served here. Publishing the term and encumbrance would defeat the proofs that exist to keep them private.
residentLookup.revokedBannerBody: Its leaf has been removed from the tree, so no proof of ownership can be produced for it. The reason is recorded on chain as a code.
residentLookup.timelineEmpty: Nothing has been recorded for this plot yet.

govShell.outOfSyncTitle: The database and the chain disagree
govShell.outOfSyncBody: A draft may have been signed but not confirmed yet, or the local node was restarted while the database kept its rows. Open the waiting draft, or check the node.
govShell.draftOpenIssuance: Issuance draft #{id} is waiting to be signed or confirmed.
govShell.draftOpenChangeset: Change set draft #{id} is waiting to be signed or confirmed.

govDraft.chainUnavailable: The registry contract could not be read
govDraft.stepConnect: Connect the officer wallet that holds the state-authority role to sign this root.
govDraft.stepWrongChain: The wallet is on chain {actual}. This registry is on chain {expected}; a root signed elsewhere is one the registry never reads.
govDraft.stepNoRole: {account} does not hold STATE_AUTHORITY_ROLE on this registry. Select the authority account in the wallet.
govDraft.stepSign: Sign the new root with the wallet. Nothing in the registry changes until the transaction is mined and the draft is confirmed.
govDraft.stepConfirm: This root is already on chain. Confirm to apply the draft to the registry.
govDraft.mining: Waiting for the transaction to be mined
govDraft.confirming: Applying the draft to the registry
govDraft.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? Nothing was published; its contents return to the queue.
govDraft.invalidatesProofs: Publishing replaces the root every issued Merkle proof refers to. Owners refresh their proof automatically before proving.
govDraft.pendingTransfers: {count} transfer(s) awaiting approval were proven against the current root. Once this publishes, approving them fails with RootMismatch and both parties must return to the counter.
govDraft.notOnChainYet: The chain does not hold this root yet

govErrors.badRequest: The registry rejected the request as invalid
govErrors.unauthorized: The portal key is no longer valid
govErrors.conflict: The registry refused this in its current state
govErrors.unprocessable: The registry could not apply this
govErrors.rootMismatch: The registry root has moved on since this proof was made
govErrors.staleTimestamp: The proof timestamp is outside the 10-minute window
govErrors.invalidProof: The proof is not cryptographically valid
govErrors.unreachable: Could not reach the registry API
govErrors.walletRejected: The signature was cancelled in the wallet
govErrors.walletDuplicateRoot: This root is already the latest root on chain
govErrors.walletNoRole: The wallet account does not hold the state-authority role
govErrors.walletAlreadyRevoked: A plot in this change set is already revoked on chain; discard the draft
govErrors.walletInvalidRevocation: The contract rejected the revocation data; discard the draft
govErrors.walletUnknown: The transaction did not go through

residentShell.readOnlyNote: This page only reads the blockchain. No wallet, no sign-in, nothing to install.
residentShell.configUnavailableTitle: Could not reach the registry API
residentShell.configUnavailableBody: The portal asks the registry which chain and which contracts to read. Without that answer it cannot check anything on chain.
residentShell.chainUnreachableBody: The contract addresses loaded, but the node did not answer. Checks that need the chain are reported as unavailable rather than passed.

residentErrors.badRequest: The registry rejected the request as invalid
residentErrors.unauthorized: This page is not allowed to read that
residentErrors.conflict: The registry refused this in its current state
residentErrors.unprocessable: The registry could not apply this
residentErrors.rootMismatch: The registry root has moved on since this proof was made
residentErrors.staleTimestamp: The proof timestamp is outside the 10-minute window
residentErrors.invalidProof: The proof is not cryptographically valid
residentErrors.unreachable: Could not reach the registry API
residentErrors.notIssued: This plot has not been issued yet
residentErrors.vkeyMissing: The registry cannot serve a proof right now
residentErrors.artifactsMissing: This deployment is missing its proving files

residentRevocation.detailOffChainNote: Only the reason code and a hash of the written explanation go on chain. The explanation itself is held by the issuing authority and can be requested from them.
